items.description: One target-specific notification delivery record, including delivery and acknowledgement state.

acknowledgedOn.description: Time the target acknowledged the notification.

acknowledgement.description: Optional JSON acknowledgement value serialized as text.

deliveredOn.description: Time the target marked the notification delivered.

error.description: Delivery error detail when sending failed.

message.description: Typed notification message; its discriminator selects email, push, or another installed message subtype.
message.title: AbstractNotificationMessage

realm.description: Realm associated with the delivery record.

sentOn.description: Time the notification was sent or attempted.

source.description: Kind of actor that created the notification.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the user, rule, or component that created the notification.

targetId.description: User, asset, realm, or custom target identifier.

items.title: SentNotification

400.description: The request parameters or body are invalid

401.description: Authentication is required or the supplied credentials are invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have permission to perform this operation
